name: b10_acrylic
cite: B-10-loaded acrylic (PMMA C5H8O2) slow-neutron-capture shell, layer C-104 (research doc: '~0.32 cm B-10 in acrylic', predetonation-background reduction). The B-10 LOADING FRACTION is NOT cited numerically in open sources; 5 wt% B-10 is a SIM placeholder pending a cited value (see data/materials/README.md). Layer C-104 has no appendix mass, so this material is NOT mass-gated. Density 1.20 g/cm3 (acrylic ~1.18 + B loading, SIM).
